title: Auto-Alpha: A Framework for Autonomous Factor Research
abstract_en: Autonomous factor research requires generating economic hypotheses as well as implementing and testing them. We present Auto-Alpha, a framework that connects report-guided initialization to self-directed research through a test-driven implementation loop. An idea agent proposes economic mechanisms and signal constructions; a research agent develops them with backtest feedback. Semantic audit, quantitative review, and human admission select factors for a persistent library, while an Experience Library retains research insights. Starting from 120 research reports, Auto-Alpha builds an initial library of 32 factors. It then generates new ideas and refines existing candidates, producing 420 implementations and retaining 62 additional factors. We evaluate factor quality and portfolio performance using a fixed library snapshot of 105 factors. The median 1-day Rank IC is 0.0301, and a weekly Top-300 portfolio returns 16.81% annualized after stated costs over 2020-2026, versus 1.71% for the CSI 1000 price index. These retrospective results document an operating research process and its artifacts; controlled evaluation is needed to isolate the contribution of its components.
abstract_zh: 自主因子研究不仅要提出经济假设，还要将其转化为可实现、可检验的交易信号。Auto-Alpha 以研究报告为起点，通过测试驱动的实现循环开展自主研究：构思智能体提出经济机制和信号构造方案，研究智能体根据回测反馈实现并迭代候选因子。候选因子经语义审计、定量评审和人工审批后进入持久化因子库，研究心得则由 Experience Library 保存。框架从 120 份报告中建立了包含 32 个因子的初始库，随后探索新想法并改进已有候选，共产出 420 个因子实现，新增保留 62 个因子。作者使用包含 105 个因子的固定快照进行评估：1 日 Rank IC 中位数为 0.0301；2020–2026 年间，按周调仓的 Top-300 组合扣除文中所述成本后，年化收益率为 16.81%，同期 CSI 1000 价格指数为 1.71%。这些回溯结果展示了研究流程及其产出，但各组件的独立贡献仍需通过对照实验验证。
key_points_zh: 构思智能体提出经济机制和信号，研究智能体根据回测反馈迭代实现。
语义审计、定量评审和人工审批共同把关因子入库，Experience Library 保存研究经验。
从 120 份报告提炼出 32 个初始因子；后续产出 420 个因子实现，新增保留 62 个。
在包含 105 个因子的固定快照中，1 日 Rank IC 中位数为 0.0301；Top-300 组合扣除所述成本后年化收益率为 16.81%，同期 CSI 1000 价格指数为 1.71%。
结果来自回溯评估，尚不能分离各组件对表现的独立贡献。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 框架用回测反馈驱动代码修订，并让后续研究复用积累的因子和经验；轨迹记录支持该机制，但未隔离能力增益，也未显示改进机制本身有演化。
agent-harness-evolution.quote:
Existing factors can expose combinations or mechanisms worth investigating, while experience entries can suggest
applicable constructions or pitfalls. Each new idea enters the same research and assessment process. Further factors and
lessons update the resources available to later attempts.

agent-memory.reason: 经验库把成败经验提炼为可追溯、有适用条件的条目，供后续研究检索、检验和修订；记录支持实际复用，但未隔离记忆带来的性能增益。
agent-memory.quote:
An entry should retain the setting in which the observation arose and the source run. During a later
investigation, the agent can retrieve the insight, assess whether its assumptions apply, and test an associated action.
Research can then add or revise an entry, making knowledge accumulation a cross-run process.
